# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 (at start), 12 (later)  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** crow  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is a young girl of about eleven or twelve with dark black hair.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, kind, sensitive, and devoted to her close friends. She can be timid and easily apprehensive when facing authority or conflict, often relying on others like Nell for boldness. She enjoys dramatic play, creative pastimes, and nature, participating enthusiastically in school and imaginative activities.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P84](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0084), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030), [v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039)_

## Goals

- Maintain her deep, lifelong friendship with Nell  <sub>[v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030)</sub>

## History

Isolde was named by a visiting schoolmaster who lodged at her family's house on Pear Hill. She grew up in Brierley and became a close classmate and bosom friend of Nell Harcourt. She pledged eternal loyalty and affection to Nell, exchanging letters, tissue paper bookmarks, and secret signals between their homes. When Miss Pembroke visited her family home, Isolde was apprehensive after a chaotic bedroom encounter, but Nell successfully mediated with Miss Pembroke on her behalf, leading to Miss Pembroke presenting Isolde with a silver bangle bracelet. Isolde attended Brierley School under Miss Agnes Thorne, participating in recitations, dialogues, and field trips alongside her classmates Opal Pettigrew and Odette Pullen. Though her mother at times restricted her communication with Nell, Isolde maintained her deep affection for her friend.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 c17 P30](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0030), [v1 c17 P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c19 P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091)_
